assign.request: the right sidebar needs a fixed size, it shouldn't grow/shrink when switching selection (which causes the viewport area to resize). the grip on the left/right sidebars is offset in a strange way. i had you do this, because the grip for the devbar was appearing even when the devbar was off screen. an alternative solution, is to just push the devbar further off screen. another quick fix for the devbar: when we resize the window, the devbar jumps from off screen right to off screen bottom, but you can see it transitioning, appearing for a brief moment. we don't want to see a flicker, it looks glitchy.
assign.now: scoping - reading brief, grip.css, playground.css, devbar.css
steps: fix the rail width mechanism (or report the reproduction failed)
mirror ext/grip anchors for start-docked rails
prove all three headless (ui-test screenshots + assertions)

log.msg: REPRODUCTION item 1: the OUTER rects never move. .pg-properties / .pg-canvas / .pg-viewport / .pg-tree each held ONE value across every selection, at 1280 (7 nodes) and 3440 (47 nodes), under six conditions: default, persisted --pg-props 500px, --pg-props 100px (clamped to 196), devbar open, viewport preset 1280, both floors off, plus a 47-node tall document. props 270.719px at 1280 / 324px at 3440; canvas 540.063 / 2554.406; viewport 479.906 / 2482.406. Zero variance, third decimal.

REPRODUCTION item 1, what DOES move: .pg-properties-body vertical overflow toggles with selection - false for a Box (7-9 fields), true for Flex (11) and Grid (13). Where a scrollbar occupies layout space (every desktop Chrome/Edge on Windows at default settings = the owner's) that toggle takes and returns ~15px of the column's CONTENT width on exactly the Box<->Flex/Grid switch the owner named, reflowing every field. Headless cannot show the 15px: bundled Chromium 151 AND channel:chrome, both with --disable-features=OverlayScrollbar,FluentOverlayScrollbar, report offsetWidth-clientWidth === 0 - overlay scrollbars, unconditionally. That environmental gap is why the mastermind's probe read stable.

DECISION item 1: do NOT touch the width mechanism. flex: 0 0 clamp() with flex-grow 0 and flex-shrink 0 cannot change on selection by construction, and the measurements prove it does not - changing it would be fixing blind. Fix the one thing that does move: scrollbar-gutter: stable on .pg-properties-body. Reserves the gutter permanently where a scrollbar takes space, no-op where it does not, one declaration, and the JS/CSS clamp agreement (Playground.js write()) is untouched.

ITEM 2 measured, before: .pg-tree rail right edge (the tree/canvas boundary) 469.22; strip 457.22-469.22 correctly flipped by the playground override, but the 2px ::before drew at 457.22-459.22 - 10px SHORT of the boundary. That is the owner's strange offset, quantified. .pg-properties (end-docked, unchanged path) drew at 1010.28, 1px past its 1009.28 boundary - absolute insets resolve against the PADDING box and the rail carries border-inline-start: 1px, so the lit line sits immediately beside the border rather than on it. Left alone: it reads as one lit edge, and pulling it out to -1px starts straddling the edge the wholly-inside rule forbids.

ITEM 2 verified, after: .pg-tree grip class 'grip grip-start', line 467.22-469.22, gap_to_boundary 0.00 (was -10), strip wholly inside the rail. Both Playground grips still drag: tree 240.63 -> 334.00 on a +100px drag (stored tree:334px), props 270.72 -> 364.00 on a -100px drag (stored props:364px), each exactly +100 measured between the two moves past the first-move snap. End-docked consumers untouched: devbar grip class 'grip', line on the rail's inline-start edge (screenshot); drawer grip class 'grip', gap_to_boundary 1.00 - the same 1px border inset, identical to before.

ITEM 3 verified, before AND after in one run: 55 rAF frames sampled while the bar was CLOSED and the viewport crossed 1280 -> 500. With the fix: visible_frames 0, onscreen_while_visible 0 - the mid-frame shows the bar at left 119 top 804 inside a 500px viewport, so the transform morph still happens, invisibly. With visibility forced back on (an injected style reproducing the old CSS): visible_frames 55, onscreen_while_visible 10 - ten frames, about 170ms, of a 500x405 panel drawn at left 458 then 369 then further in. That is the owner's flicker, counted. Open/close still animates at both poses: 1280 fires transitionstart+transitionend on transform, visibility visible, left 1280 -> 1008; below 34em closed is visibility hidden at translateY(405) with top 900 = innerHeight, opens to top 495, closes back to hidden.

ITEM 1 verified after the fix: scrollbar-gutter computes 'stable'; at 1280 across 47 selections and at 3440 across 7 selections x six conditions (default, --pg-props 500px, --pg-props clamped low, devbar open, viewport preset 1280, floors off) every column holds ONE value - props/canvas/viewport/tree unchanged, and .pg-properties-body's INNER width is now constant too (270->255 at 1280, 323->308 at 3440: Chromium reserves the 15px gutter even under overlay scrollbars, so the cost is paid everywhere and the jump is gone everywhere). The 15px is permanent and the rail is drag-resizable, so it is recoverable; that is the trade the owner's fixed-size ask buys.

PARKED, one line as the brief asked: pushing the devbar further off screen is unnecessary. The grip is inside the box, a 100% slide clears it, and visibility:hidden while closed already makes the closed rail unhittable - the owner's original reason for the offset grip is answered without moving anything.

assign.outcome:
**Three fixes, all measured** - the right rail no longer shifts on a selection switch, both Playground grips light the edge they actually drag, and the closed dev rail crosses 34em without a flicker.

| what | before | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| .pg-properties outer width, per selection | 270.719px / 324px, already fixed | unchanged (was never the bug) |
| .pg-properties-body inner width | jumps ~15px when the field count crosses overflow (Box 7-9, Flex 11, Grid 13) | constant - 255px at 1280, 308px at 3440 |
| .pg-tree grip lit line vs the tree/canvas boundary | **10px short** | **0.00px** |
| dev rail on-screen frames while closed, resizing 1280 -> 500 | **10 of 55** (~170ms of a 500x405 panel) | **0 of 55** |

**Item 1 - reproduce first, and the answer was no.** The outer rects never move: props / canvas / viewport / tree each held ONE value to the third decimal across 7 selections at 1280 and 47 at 3440, under six conditions (default, persisted --pg-props 500px, one clamped low, dev rail open, 1280 viewport preset, floors off). `flex: 0 0 clamp()` with grow and shrink at 0 cannot vary with content. What varies is the column INSIDE: `overflow: auto` plus a selection-dependent field count, so the scrollbar toggles on exactly the Box<->Flex/Grid switch the owner named. Fix is one declaration, `scrollbar-gutter: stable`; the width mechanism and its JS/CSS clamp agreement are untouched.

⚠ **Headless cannot see this bug.** Chromium 151 and `channel: "chrome"` with `--disable-features=OverlayScrollbar,FluentOverlayScrollbar` both report `offsetWidth - clientWidth === 0`. That is why two probes read "stable". Logged to the ui-test skill.

**Item 2 - fixed at the cause.** `grip({ from: "start" })` now stamps `.grip-start` and `ext/grip` mirrors strip and lit line together; `playground.css`'s override is deleted. Both Playground grips still drag exactly +/-100px and persist. Drawer and dev rail (default `from`) byte-identical - the wholly-inside rule stands on its own reasons.

**Item 3 - visibility-gated.** Closed is `visibility: hidden` delayed 0.18s; `dev-open` clears the delay. The transform morph still happens, invisibly. Open/close fires transitionstart+transitionend on transform at both poses.

![tree grip on the boundary](grip-tree-boundary.png)

**Not done, deliberately:** pushing the dev rail further off screen - unnecessary, a closed rail is now unhittable because the whole box is hidden. The properties grip's remaining **1px** offset is the rail's own `border-inline-start`: absolute insets resolve against the padding box, the 1px border and the 2px line read as one lit edge, and pulling out to -1px would start straddling. `.pg-tree-body` has the same scrollbar-toggle shape but is not selection-driven; left alone.
